mmorpg.profession.desc.alchemy: Alchemy is a crafting profession that turns materials from gathering professions into Potions.
mmorpg.profession.desc.cooking: Cooking is a crafting profession that turns materials from gathering professions into foods that can provide stat buffs.
mmorpg.profession.desc.enchanting: Infusing is a crafting profession that turns materials from gathering professions into scrolls that can infuse extra power into your gear.
mmorpg.profession.desc.farming: Farming gives you a chance to obtain extra custom materials by chopping wheat, potatoes and so on. You can see what gives experience in the Mine and Slash HUB > Library screen.
mmorpg.profession.desc.fishing: Fishing gives you a chance to obtain extra custom materials by fishing.
mmorpg.profession.desc.gear_crafting: Gear Crafting is a crafting profession that turns materials from gathering professions into new pieces of gear.
mmorpg.profession.desc.husbandry: Bounty Hunting enables you to take on tasks from the Bountiful Boards for rewards, including Cooking Profession Meats.
mmorpg.profession.desc.mining: Mining gives you chance to obtain extra custom materials by mining ores. You can see which ores give experience in the Mine and Slash HUB > Library screen.
mmorpg.profession.desc.salvaging: Salvaging is the process of turning junk loot into useful materials in the Salvaging Station. You can only salvage Gear with Mine and Slash souls and other Mine and Slash rarity items.

spell.desc.fury:
§6This [buff](buff) is needed for the rest of the Brawler Skills!§7

Empower yourself with wrath, giving your [basic attacks](basic_attack) the chance to generate a [Combo Starter](combo) stack, which is used to use Brawler Skills.
spell.desc.zen: Enter a state of calm, increasing your Health [Regen](regeneration) and giving your [basic attacks](basic_attack) the chance to recover [calc:energy_recover] [Energy](energy) to you and nearby [allies](allies).
spell.desc.eighth_gate:
Open your inner gate and deal [calc:eighth_gate] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage to yourself to immediately gain a [Combo Extender](combo) stack. For 6s, you regenerate Health more slowly but deal increased [Attack Damage](attack_damage).

§oIncreases to Damage and [Critical Hits](critical_hit) don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!§r
spell.desc.piercing_strike:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Starter](combo) stack.§7

Quickly strike the area in front of you, dealing [calc:piercing_strike] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage to enemies [hit](hit_damage). Enemies [hit](hit_damage) also gain a stack of Shred, losing [Armor](armour) for 10s.

§aGenerates a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.debilitating_blow:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Starter](combo) stack.§7

Assault the area in front of you, dealing [calc:debilitating_blow] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage to enemies in the area. Enemies [hit](hit_damage) are also [slowed](slow) and have their Damage reduced for a short duration.

§aGenerates a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.goading_strike:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Starter](combo) stack.§7

Deal [calc:goading_strike] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage to enemies in front of you and Taunt them. Enemies caught also gain increased Damage Taken, and have their [Dodge Rating](dodge_rating) reduced.

§aGenerates a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.elemental_assault:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Starter](combo) stack.§7

Blast the area in front of you with the elements, dealing [calc:elemental_assault] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7, §b☀ [Cold](cold_damage)§7, and §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage. Upon use, your §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage is converted to the elements for 6s.

§aGenerates a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.sweeping_blow:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Starter](combo) stack.§7

Sweep the area around you with a kick, stunning enemies and dealing [calc:sweeping_blow] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage. Enemies [hit](hit_damage) also get pulled to you.

§aGenerates a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.triple_blitz:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7

Rapidly strike enemies in front of you three times, with each [hit](hit_damage) dealing [calc:triple_blitz] §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage.

§aGenerates a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.rallying_sweep:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7

Perform a sweeping kick around you, dealing [calc:rallying_sweep] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage to nearby enemies. Additionally, nearby [allies](allies) gain increased Damage and Move Speed.

§aGenerates a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.anti_gravity_smash:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7

Slam the ground in front of you, damaging enemies for [calc:anti_gravity_smash_initial] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage, and causing a black hole to arise from above and come crashing down. Enemies caught in the black hole rapidly take [calc:anti_gravity_smash] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage every 0.1s.

§aGenerates a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.flowing_river_rush:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7

Fire a cold blast which teleports you to it and deals [calc:flowing_river_rush] §b☀ [Cold](cold_damage)§7 Damage to enemies upon impact. Additionally, the explosion will apply [Stun](stun) to nearby enemies and form a pool of freezing water which deals [calc:flowing_river_rush] §b☀ [Cold](cold_damage)§7 Damage per second.

§aGenerates a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.spirit_offensive:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Linker](combo) stack.§7

Fire a piercing spirit orb which deals [calc:spirit_offensive] §5☀ [Chaos](chaos_damage)§7 Damage to enemies [hit](hit_damage). Once the orb reaches the end of its path, it returns to where it was fired, once again dealing [calc:spirit_offensive] §5☀ [Chaos](chaos_damage)§7 Damage. Additionally, whenever the orb [hits](hit_damage) an enemy, it heals you for [calc:spirit_offensive_heal] Health.

§aGenerates a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7
spell.desc.raging_dragon:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7

Strike the area around you with the force of a raging dragon, §eknocking back§7 and dealing [calc:raging_dragon_slam] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 Damage in an area around you and sending out a massive fire dragon that encircles you. The dragon spins around you, rapidly dealing [calc:raging_dragon] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 Damage every 0.2s in an area to enemies caught in its path.
spell.desc.glacial_phoenix:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7

Slam your weapon into the ground, §eknocking back§7 and dealing [calc:glacial_phoenix] §b☀ [Cold](cold_damage)§7 Damage to enemies in front of you. Due to impact, the area remains shattered, causing ice shards every 0.2s to fall from the sky above all [hit](hit_damage) enemies. Each ice shard deals [calc:glacial_phoenix] §b☀ [Cold](cold_damage)§7 Damage to any enemies caught in their path. The area's overall boundary size is fixed and unaffected by [Area of Effect](area_of_effect) modifiers, but modifiers will increase the impact radius of individual ice shards.
spell.desc.storming_tiger:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7

Invoke the spirit of the tiger and very rapidly strike enemies around you, dealing [calc:storming_tiger] §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage per [hit](hit_damage). On the final strike, also fire out a nova of Chain Lightning projectiles, with each chaining twice and dealing [calc:storming_tiger_lightning] §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage.
spell.desc.omnislash:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7

Channel your Brawler strength into eight rapid and fearsome strikes, with each [hit](hit_damage) briefly applying [Stun](stun) and dealing [calc:omnislash] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage.
spell.desc.asura:
§cRequires and consumes a [Combo Extender](combo) stack.§7

Surpass your limits to damage nearby enemies for [calc:asura] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage and yourself for [calc:asura_self] §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage.

§oIncreases to Damage and [Critical Hits](critical_hit) don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!§r
spell.desc.safeguard:
§6This [buff](buff) is needed to gain Retribution stacks used in the other Crusader Skills!§7

Enhance yourself with the ability to defend your [allies](allies). Grants you Passive [Block Chance](block), Health, and the chance to gain Retribution on successful blocks. §aYou can have up to 5 Retribution stacks.§7
spell.desc.holy_shield_throw:
Throw out a spiritual shield which deals [calc:holy_shield_throw] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 and §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage in an area upon contact. The damage is also influenced by your Passive [Block Chance](block).

§eRetribution§7: Consume a Retribution stack to also apply Judgment on enemies [hit](hit_damage), causing them to gain increased Damage Taken.
spell.desc.blessed_hammer:
Throw out a spiritual hammer which spirals around you, gaining momentum as it travels. The hammer pierces enemies and deals [calc:blessed_hammer] §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage to enemies [hit](hit_damage).

§eRetribution§7: Consume a Retribution stack to throw out 2 additional hammers around you.
spell.desc.martyrdom:
Sacrifice [calc:martyrdom_self] Health as §6☀ [Physical](physical_damage)§7 Damage to heal nearby [allies](allies) (excluding yourself) for [calc:martyrdom].

§eRetribution§7: Consume a Retribution stack to prevent Martyrdom from dealing damage to yourself.

§oIncreases to Damage and [Critical Hits](critical_hit) don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!§r
spell.desc.persecutory_thrust:
Thrust your blade forward, channeling a piercing, holy beam which deals [calc:persecutory_thrust] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 and §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage to enemies in your way. While channeling the beam, also deal [calc:persecutory_thrust_self] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 and §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage to yourself.

§eRetribution§7: Consume a Retribution stack to prevent the beam from dealing damage to yourself.

§oIncreases to Damage and [Critical Hits](critical_hit) don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!§r
spell.desc.reckoners_flail:
Throw out an ignited chain which chains and [hits](hit_damage) additional enemies. Each [hit](hit_damage) from the chain deals [calc:reckoners_flail] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 Damage and pulls them to you.

§eRetribution§7: Consume a Retribution stack to also apply [Stun](stun) to all enemies [hit](hit_damage) for 4s.
spell.desc.comeuppance:
Slam your weapon into the ground to send out a shockwave which deals [calc:comeuppance] §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage in a large area around you.

§eRetribution§7: Consume a Retribution stack to also [Slow](slow) and Taunt enemies in the area.
spell.desc.fist_of_judgment:
Sacrifice your own Health, dealing [calc:fist_of_judgment_self] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 and §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage to yourself to mark an area with your blood. After 2.25s, the marked area is slammed with the power of the Gods, §eknocking back§7 and dealing [calc:fist_of_judgment] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 and §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage in an area.

§eRetribution§7: Consume a Retribution stack to also heal [allies](allies) in the marked area for [calc:fist_of_judgment] Health.

§oIncreases to Damage and [Critical Hits](critical_hit) don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!§r
spell.desc.holy_immolation: Imbue your flames with Holy power. Holy Immolation sacrifices Burn Damage to give your Burn [Ailment](ailment) a chance to deal [calc:immolate] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 Damage in an area around the enemy on the initial Burn proc.
spell.desc.immolate: On the initial Burn proc, deal [calc:immolate] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 Damage in an area around the enemy.
spell.desc.prayer:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Prayer [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby [allies](allies) heal for [calc:prayer] Health and [Magic Shield](magic_shield) each second. They also gain the Prayer Effect, which provides a bonus to Healing Received.

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time. You can also view the Prayer Effect in the Mine and Slash Library, available through the HUB.§7
spell.desc.blessed_aim:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Blessed Aim [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby [allies](allies) gain the Blessed Aim Effect, which increases [Critical Hit](critical_hit) and [Accuracy](accuracy).

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time.§7
spell.desc.defiance:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Defiance [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby [allies](allies) gain the Defiance Effect, which provides a bonuses to [Armor](armour) and a small amount of [Damage Reduction](damage_reduction).

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time.§7
spell.desc.holy_shock:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Holy Shock [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby [allies](allies) gain the Holy Shock Effect, which increases §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage and provides Physical to Lightning. Additionally, nearby enemies take [calc:holy_shock] §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage every 2s.

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time.§7
spell.desc.fanaticism:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Fanaticism [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby [allies](allies) gain the Fanaticism Effect, which increases [Attack Speed](attack_speed), [Magic Skill Speed](cast_time), Move Speed, and Roll [Cooldown](cooldown).

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time.§7
spell.desc.meditation:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Meditation [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby [allies](allies) gain the Meditation Effect, which substantially increases [Mana](mana) and [Energy](energy) [Regeneration](regeneration).

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time.§7
spell.desc.concentration:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Concentration [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby [allies](allies) gain the Concentration Effect, which increases Damage dealt.

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time.§7
spell.desc.redemption:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Redemption [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby [allies](allies) gain the Redemption Effect, which provides substantial Health and [Magic Shield](magic_shield) on Kill.

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time.§7
spell.desc.salvation:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Salvation [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby [allies](allies) gain the Salvation Effect, which increases Elemental [Resistances](resistances).

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time.§7
spell.desc.holy_fire:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Holy Fire [Aura](aura) on yourself. While active, nearby enemies take [calc:holy_fire] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 Damage every 0.5s, and you take [calc:holy_fire_self] §c☀ [Fire](fire_damage)§7 Damage every 0.5s. This damage also scales off of your Max Health. If damage is dealt to yourself while below 25% Health, the [Aura](aura) will remove itself.

§cYou can only have ONE [Aura](aura) active at a time.§7

§oIncreases to Damage and [Critical Hits](critical_hit) don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!§r
spell.desc.zap:
Fire a small and quick projectile which chains once. Each [hit](hit_damage) deals [calc:zap] §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage. If under the effect of Cold Snap's §eConduction§7, each [hit](hit_damage) will also leave behind a static zone which explodes after 1s, dealing [calc:zap] §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage to enemies in an area.

§aGenerates an §dAlpha§7 §astack upon cast. You can have up to 3§7 §dAlpha§7 §astacks.§7
spell.desc.cold_snap:
Crash an area in front of you with snow and ice, causing an implosion of ice clusters, dealing [calc:cold_snap] §b☀ [Cold](cold_damage)§7 Damage to enemies in an area. If under the effect of Zap's §eConduction§7, the ice clusters will explode, spewing shrapnel in all directions with each shard dealing [calc:cold_snap_half] §b☀ [Cold](cold_damage)§7 Damage. Note that these shards are not considered projectiles.

§aGenerates a §bBeta§7 §astack upon cast. You can have up to 3§7 §bBeta§7 §astacks.§7
spell.desc.time_dilation: [Slow](slow) down time for everything but yourself, causing you to move quicker and nearby enemies to move slower.
spell.desc.conduction:
Generate synergies with Zap and Cold Snap. Also provides synergies between §e☀ [Lightning](lightning_damage)§7 Damage and §b☀ [Cold](cold_damage)§7 Damage. While Conduction is active, casts of Zap or Cold Snap will temporarily alter the effect of the other:

Zap casts will cause Cold Snap explosions to additionally fire shrapnel in all directions, with each shrapnel shard dealing half the damage of Cold Snap. The shrapnel is not considered as a projectile.

Cold Snap casts will cause Zap to leave behind a static field which detonates after 1s dealing the same damage again.
spell.desc.fusion: Using the power of technology, slam together an §dAlpha§7 and §bBeta§7 stack to generate a §eGamma§7 stack. You can have up to 3§7 §eGamma§7 stacks.
